name: Zoho Forms Free
free_limit: Three hosted forms, 500 submissions/month, 200 MB file storage and one user on the Free plan; includes up to ten payment submissions per month and basic webhook integrations.
watch_out: The 500-submission limit resets monthly. Multi-user access, branding removal, custom domains and some advanced workflow options require paid tiers; payment processor fees can apply separately. Free plan card requirement and commercial-use terms are not explicitly verified.
